what: What actually happened in every game that has been played, so the cost model on costs.html runs on counts instead of typed-in estimates. M18 item 10.
rule: No number is put in this file by hand. Every figure here is a count written by the game, and a count of something that happened. An empty list is not a zero: while `games` is empty, costs.html keeps its ESTIMATE tags and shows the counters as NOT COUNTED. It switches to MEASURED the moment this file holds a game.

shape.days: how long it ran, after joining closed
shape.fights: attacks started, counted over the whole game - not per player
shape.challenges: one-on-one matches settled, counted over the whole game
shape.randomNumbers: Entropy requests the game paid for
shape.writes: transactions the game sent on players' behalf, counted - not worked out from the two above

owed.the write counter: M6, where writing to the chain is built
